name: MapSettingsTuner
title: 地图设置调整器
author: Gpx
description:
在游戏运行中随时修改地图设置与地图生成设置。地图生成的改动只对新生成的区块生效。

致谢：本模组最初由 Bilka 创作并开发（上游 “Change Map Settings” 5.0.1 版，MIT 许可）。2.1 版本适配由 Gpx 维护。感谢 Bilka 的原始开发贡献与开源授权。

Allows you to change map and map generation settings at any time. Map generation changes only apply to new chunks.

Credits: originally created and developed by Bilka (upstream "Change Map Settings" 5.0.1, MIT license). Factorio 2.1 adaptation maintained by Gpx. Thank you, Bilka.
